description.en: Parametric and interactively editable laser-cut ball-bearing tilt maze with stacked layers, clear acrylic cover, engraved start/goal markers, and free wall design.

en.name: Labyrinth / Tilt Maze
en.desc: Stacked laser-cut ball-bearing tilt maze: generate parametrically, edit every wall interactively, or design your own paths from scratch.

en.label: Labyrinth {cols} × {rows}
